title: St. Joseph Man Sentenced to 50 Years Imprisonment for Drug & Money Laundering Conspiracy
snippet: Montrez Dixon, 33, of St. Joseph, Mo., was sentenced in federal court today for his role in a conspiracy to commit drug trafficking and money laundering.

title: Extradited Mexican Citizen Sentenced to Federal Prison for Conspiracy to Distribute Heroin
snippet: A Mexican man was sentenced to federal prison today for drug distribution.

title: Homeland Security Task Force: Five Plead Guilty to Importing Thousands of Kilograms of Cocaine into South Florida
snippet: Five defendants pleaded guilty to conspiring to import thousands of kilograms of cocaine into South Florida aboard sport fishing vessels from the Dominican Republic.

title: Washington man sentenced to 19 years for trafficking fentanyl into Montana while armed
snippet: A Washington man who trafficked fentanyl from Seattle to Missoula while carrying a loaded handgun was sentenced today to 19 years in prison, followed by five years of supervised release.

title: Alleged Irish Crime Boss Charged After UAE Extradition
snippet: The alleged leader of a major Irish organized crime group was extradited from Dubai and charged with directing a criminal organization. Appearing without a lawyer, he told the court: “I think we know I won’t be getting bail.”

title: Head of FinCEN Leaving to Join Citibank as Global Head of Sanctions
